'''Jans Tolen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He eventually became the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Stark Wing]]'' and in c. [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] he commanded the ship during an assignment in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. The craft encountered a number of [[Oblee|shadow lurkers]]&mdash;the incorporeal spirits of members of the Oblee [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;which attempted to contact the Thaereians by possessing a number of the ''Stark Wing''{{'s}} crew. However, this caused the Thaereians to believe that they were being invaded, and the crew began attacking each other. Tolen transferred data from the ship to the [[Thaereian High Command]] and traveled to his quarters, where he recorded a final entry in the ship's log, and deleted all of the previous log entries. He then held a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] to his neck and [[Death/Legends|killed himself]]. The ''Stark Wing'' and Tolen's corpse were later rediscovered by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
